    'Full-Stack Software Engineer',

    'Cloud & Distributed Backend Engineer',

  socials: [

      id: 'linkedin',

};

export const EXPERIENCE_DATA: ExperienceEntry[] = [
  {
    id: 'centralogic-fullstack',

      {
        domain: 'Full-Stack & API Engineering',
        title: 'Scalable Web Applications & Versioned REST Services',
        description:
          'Architected and delivered end-to-end web applications and backend services using Node.js, TypeScript, Express.js, NestJS, React (Hooks, Redux, Tailwind CSS), and ASP.NET Core (C#), governed by strict OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.',
        technologies: ['Node.js', 'TypeScript', 'React.js', 'NestJS', 'ASP.NET Core', 'OpenAPI/Swagger'],
      },
      {
        domain: 'Applied AI & Agentic Workflows',
        title: 'Deterministic AI Integrations & MCP Tooling',
        description:
          'Built provider-agnostic LLM integrations and Model Context Protocol (MCP) agent tools that pair read-only analytical data retrieval with post-generation fact validators and safe refusal guardrails.',
        technologies: ['OpenAI API', 'Claude Agents', 'MCP', 'LLM Tool Calling', 'Prompt Design', 'Databricks'],
      },
      {
        domain: 'Document Automation & Cloud Pipelines',
        title: 'Serverless & Containerized Document Processing',

          'Designed asynchronous document ingestion, PDF data extraction, and multi-jurisdiction rule validation pipelines running on AWS Lambda, ECS Fargate, S3, and SQS with Docker containerization.',

      },
      {
        domain: 'Database & Performance Optimization',
        title: 'High-Throughput Storage, Indexing & Distributed Caching',
        description:
          'Optimized relational and NoSQL data access patterns across PostgreSQL, AWS DynamoDB, and Azure Cosmos DB—refining composite indexes, partition-key strategies, and Redis caching layers to reduce lookup latency.',
        technologies: ['PostgreSQL', 'Redis', 'AWS DynamoDB', 'Azure Cosmos DB', 'SQL Optimization'],
      },
      {
        domain: 'Quality, Observability & CI/CD',
        title: 'Automated Delivery Pipelines & Test-Driven Engineering',
        description:
          'Maintained high engineering reliability with Jest unit and integration test suites (TDD), PR-based code reviews, Jenkins CI/CD automation, and production telemetry via AWS CloudWatch and Datadog.',
        technologies: ['Jest', 'TDD', 'Jenkins CI/CD', 'Datadog', 'CloudWatch', 'Git / Agile'],
      },
    ],
    coreStack: [
      'Node.js',
      'TypeScript',
      'React.js',
      'NestJS',
      'Express.js',
      'ASP.NET Core (C#)',
      'PostgreSQL',
      'Redis',

      'Azure Cosmos DB',
      'AWS Lambda & ECS Fargate',
      'Docker',
      'OpenAI API & Claude Agents',
      'Model Context Protocol (MCP)',
      'Jest & Jenkins CI/CD',
    ],
  },
];

  {

  {
